LanguageData.RC2_AgaveMosto.label: agave mosto
LanguageData.RC2_AgaveMosto.description: Agave Mosto is the name for the mashed up and fermented parts of the agave plant. Needs distillation in order to become tequila.
LanguageData.RC2_AmbrosiaMust.label: ambrosia must
LanguageData.RC2_AmbrosiaMust.description: Ambrosia Must. This mixture is made up of freshly squeezed juice from the rare ambrosia fruit and the rest of the fruit, mashed into a pulp. It is this substance that will then ferment in order to make the much-coveted Ambrosia Nectar.
LanguageData.RC2_AppleMust.label: apple must
LanguageData.RC2_AppleMust.description: Freshly squeezed apple juice along with the rest of the mashed apple. Needs to ferment in a barrel in order to make cider.
LanguageData.RC2_CoconutWort.label: coconut wort
LanguageData.RC2_CoconutWort.description: Coconut wort is made from coconut flowers and the flesh of the coconuts themselves. Its used in making Arrack.
LanguageData.RC2_CornMash.label: corn mash
LanguageData.RC2_CornMash.description: This mixture is made up of mashed corn that has fermented in a barrel. It needs to be distilled into whiskey.
LanguageData.RC2_FruitMust.label: fruit must
LanguageData.RC2_FruitMust.description: Freshly squeezed fruit juice and pulp, stems, and seeds. Needs to be fermented into fruit wine.
LanguageData.RC2_GinPrecursor.label: gin precursor
LanguageData.RC2_GinPrecursor.description: A mixture of vodka and juniper berries, this mixture needs to sit in a barrel for a bit in order for the juniper berry flavor to infuse into the vodka.
LanguageData.RC2_GrapeMust.label: grape must
LanguageData.RC2_GrapeMust.description: Freshly squeezed grape juice, pulp, and stems. This stuff needs to ferment for a while in order to become wine.
LanguageData.RC2_HoneyMust.label: honey must
LanguageData.RC2_HoneyMust.description: Made of nothing but honey and water, this mixture needs to ferment in a barrel to make mead.
LanguageData.RC2_KumisMust.label: kumis must
LanguageData.RC2_KumisMust.description: Kumis Must. Made from milk, water, and spices for use in making Kumis.
LanguageData.RC2_MoonshinePrecursor.label: moonshine precursor
LanguageData.RC2_MoonshinePrecursor.description: Made of fermented grains of questionable quality and spiked with chemfuel for strength and volume, this stuff needs to be distilled to make moonshine.
LanguageData.RC2_OatWort.label: oat wort
LanguageData.RC2_OatWort.description: Mashed and unfermented oat mixture. Needs fermentation to become stout.
LanguageData.RC2_PotatoMash.label: potato mash
LanguageData.RC2_PotatoMash.description: Fermented potato mash that needs to be distilled in order to make vodka.
LanguageData.RC2_RiceMash.label: rice mash
LanguageData.RC2_RiceMash.description: Mashed up rice that needs to ferment to become sake.
LanguageData.RC2_SugarcaneWort.label: sugarcane wort
LanguageData.RC2_SugarcaneWort.description: Fermented juices of sugarcane, this needs to be distilled further in order to make rum.
LanguageData.RC2_WheatWort.label: wheat wort
LanguageData.RC2_WheatWort.description: A mixture of wheat and hops that needs to ferment in a barrel to become ale.
